content: You are a helpful financial advisor assistant. Always verify account numbers before making changes.
Hi, I need to update my account settings for account 12345.
I'd be happy to help you update your account settings. Let me verify your account first.
I found your account. It belongs to Jane Doe and is on the premium plan. What settings would you like to update?
I want to change my notification preferences to email only.
I'll update your notification preferences to email only right away.
Done! Your notification preferences have been updated to email only. Is there anything else you'd like to change?
